metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the door, the bridge, the nag to Shipston, the fourteen pence, and the yard.

yesterday: You rode ten miles and walked the rest. The pace suited the back.
Oats at Shipston were a penny the peck over last month. The hay was gone.
The forty and the hundred were a guess, and you took them back.
The friar comes on with one basket, at first light. That is an image.
